x: Mark Proctor of N&E pulled out one of those rare long putts which the rotational specialists seem to manage, so Matt Simson had to settle for second with Lee Newman winning the 'B'.

Birchfield then came to our aid in the shot with an unknown American outthrowing Newham Mark Proctor with Matt Simson third. Then it was down to John Regis who, although pipped by Sale's Allyn Condon, managed to squeeze 6 points out of the Newham man.
Who, for example, would have predicted that Newham's Mark Proctor would elect to participate in his hobby event - the discus - and win with a 57m+ p.b.

But it was the shot where Newham finally faltered, as the often erratic Mark Proctor failed to post a distance with three no throws. To rub home the advantage Lee Newman gained silver in the 'A', beating Dave Readle who went on to win the 'B'.
